Simple acoustic sum rule on real-space matrices
Read coupling matrices, apply ASR, project modes, write original spectra

conclusion: The adapter transports the complete native coarse-q matrices and q2r coefficients correctly. The finite-grid native Fourier interpolation creates negative coupling eigenvalues before mode integration; at narrow broadening they already occur without ASR. q6 refinement reduces negative spectral weight but does not establish convergence. Keep the Fourier route rejected for this protocol.

accepted_q_sum_comparison.integration: Explicit q-point mode sum from the same q4 PH results; skips real-space Fourier interpolation by user-selected method, not a silent repair.

claim_boundary: Verified q-sum and Wannier routes can be described as tested workflows. This Al Fourier route has not passed its positivity/convergence gate and must not support a Tc claim. No threshold clipping, broadening selection or automatic route change.
